gaps.sentence: The project is ___ way to completion ahead of schedule.
The proposal was rejected ___ a single vote.
gaps.explanation: 'by a single vote / by two goals' — the margin takes 'by'.

gaps.sentence: We finished the report ___ time for the meeting.
gaps.explanation: 'in time for' = early enough; 'on time' = punctual.

gaps.sentence: The firm was put ___ liquidation by the end of March.
gaps.explanation: 'Put into liquidation' — the formal process of closing a company.'

gaps.hint: to his credit = in his favour
gaps.explanation: 'to somebody's credit' — something in their favour.

gaps.sentence: The bus was so crowded that we travelled ___ discomfort.
The venue was changed at ___ notice, just two days before.
gaps.explanation: 'At short notice' = only a short time before.

gaps.sentence: I did it ___ my own initiative — nobody asked me.
gaps.explanation: 'of one's own initiative' = without being asked.
